about: What the web copy may not say on an ORDINARY page (one outside the assistant section) while help/facts.json -> assistantOnTheWeb is false. Ruled 2026-11-12 (#804): plantoir.app never presents Plantoir as needing a paid assistant, and unit planning and Coverage as a planning tool go on the site only after GitHub Copilot support has shipped and been verified. A sentence or block that must say one of these goes in an {{assistant}} ... {{/assistant}} run: it stays in the Mac Help book and is left out of the web copy. --web and --release-web FAIL on an unmarked mention, naming its file and line; --check and --mac print it as a warning. Each term is a case-insensitive regular expression with its reason; the director may shorten the list.
